name: search-console-ai
description: Google Search Console's generative AI performance report (AI Overviews, AI Mode, Discover), which the official API does not expose. The session is read from Chrome AI, no token to copy.

tools.name: gsc_session
tools.description: Status of the connection to the site: browser (Chrome AI or Chrome) and profile used, session expiry, manual token.

tools.name: gsc_list_properties
tools.description: Search Console properties of the Google account signed in to Chrome: id to pass to the other tools, type (domain or url_prefix) and display name.

tools.name: gsc_ai_overview
tools.description: "Generative AI performance" report of a property: total impressions in Google's AI answers (AI Overviews, AI Mode), daily series, most seen pages and countries, and the split by device, each row with its share in %.

tools.name: gsc_ai_breakdown
tools.description: Full table of the AI report for one dimension: impressions by page, country, device or day, sorted as in Search Console (impressions descending, or dates ascending for date), with the share of the total in %.

chrome_source.title: Chrome source
chrome_source.description: Where the Google session is read: "ai" (default) for Chrome AI, the dedicated Chrome instance; "chrome" for your regular Chrome.

chrome_profile.title: Chrome profile (optional)
chrome_profile.description: Name or folder of the Chrome profile signed in to Google. Empty: the most recently used profile.
